summary: Small __thiscall constructor for a 4-field object. Installs the vtable off_5AD06C at +0x0, stores the caller-supplied integer a2 at +0x4 and the byte a3 at +0x8, and zero-initializes +0xC. Returns the original this pointer. Called by Direct3DObjectFactory (0x004DAEA0) during object construction; no branches, no calls.

operations.description: Save the incoming this pointer as the result value.
Store caller parameter a2 into the field at +0x4.
Store caller byte parameter a3 into the field at +0x8.

unresolved: Identity of the object type whose vtable is off_5AD06C is unknown.
Semantics of the stored parameters a2 (identifier/code) and a3 (flag byte) depend on the caller in Direct3DObjectFactory.
